## Owner intent and full design
Link the full [CIIFR Property Transfer concept note v1.0](https://github.com/reallakshman19/XML_Compare_Utilities/blob/codex/ciifr-property-two-path-r0-20261028/docs/ciifr/property-transfer/CONCEPT_NOTE_v1.0.md) into this repository and add **ONE new Property Transfer top-level tab** with **TWO independent read-only modules**:
- **Path A: Node → Element → Data**, exact FROM→TO (oriented), per-element stored T1/P1/fluid density evidence and exact physical byte spans; no assumption that all adjacent elements share process parameters.
- **Path B: Node → Data**, numeric node→incident elements, individual RESTRANT DOF/pointer, DISPLMNT/FORCMNT specs, and adjacent RIGIDs explicitly identified as element-owned.

**Preserve existing tabs:** NodeName Find & Replace, Node-Based Name Transfer, Line Number + Node Name, Geometry, CIIFR_GEO, Config. No old engine/NodeName writer/production tile edits. The only shared-app change is additive tab registration/mount/visibility; new files live under `property-transfer/` with their own SOURCE/TARGET intake.

**Implementation plan:** [R0–P6 phased gates](https://github.com/reallakshman19/XML_Compare_Utilities/blob/codex/ciifr-property-two-path-r0-20261028/docs/ciifr/property-transfer/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md).

### Current deliverable R0
- Full concept note and implementation plan committed (no private CII bytes).
- New isolated browser panel with two independent modes, local SOURCE(optional) and TARGET0 inputs, SHA-256 display, read-only element/node evidence tables, explicit `UNVERIFIED_READ_ONLY` and **no apply/export** controls.
- V14-only read-only strict physical index: CONTROL NUMELT/aux counts, ELEMENTS incidence and typed pointer custody, MISCEL_1 RRMAT minimum length, RESTRANT 24-card/6 DOF evidence, DISPLMNT/FORCMNT 20-card/2-spec, RIGID one-card element attachment. **No effective-value or vendor semantics are claimed**.
- Source and served JS/CSS/app byte-for-byte identical; existing `physical.js`, `writer.js`, `nodal-transfer.js`, `geo-tab.js` untouched.
- New Node test `tests/cii-fnr-vnext-property-transfer-r0.test.mjs` covers oriented elements, shared endpoint, process per-element data, restraint pointer, malformed section, shared pointers, missing MISC, unsupported V11, immutability and retained tab/mirror integrity.

### Author checks vs remaining gates
- **PASS (author V8 synthetic):** actual committed `physical.js` + read-only index against a bounded two-element V14 synthetic, exact FROM→TO element selection, different P1 values for two elements meeting at Node 500, one restraint DOF, intact input, malformed marker rejection. A corrected explicit shared-pointer negative rejects with `PROPERTY_SHARED_POINTER_RESTRANT`. **No independent/original-file engine verdict.**
- **PASS (source readback):** 6/6 source/served file pairs equal Git blobs; PR branch currently ahead of main with no drift.
- **NOT_RUN:** native Node test suite on exact branch, real served Chromium/Windows integration, independent original V14 via the new JS reader, all old-tab regressions, distinct non-author exact-head review, licensed CAESAR II.
- **NOT_AUTHORIZED:** SOURCE→TARGET mapping acceptance, operating/pressure/effective semantic promotion, any TARGET1/property writer, CONTROL/MISC mutation, merge/deployment. Prior Element E1 #178 and draft #187 remain their own source-semantic lane; #139 frozen writer contract not amended.
- **PROTOCOL DEVIATION:** native clone DNS unavailable; `utils/backup.cjs` and local `.agent-worklogs/` not executed. Remote immutable file preimages are preserved; report does not misstate backup compliance.

### Handover and next action
Recovery-first report: `agents/WIP-ciifr-prop-r0-20261028_workreport.md`. Related conceptual scope [#224](https://github.com/reallakshman19/XML_Compare_Utilities/issues/224), [#167](https://github.com/reallakshman19/XML_Compare_Utilities/issues/167) and [#178](https://github.com/reallakshman19/XML_Compare_Utilities/issues/178).

**DRAFT / READ_ONLY QUALIFICATION HOLD.** The next task is a genuinely independent native reviewer, exact-head Node+browser+old-tab regressions and Owner-private V14 inspection (521 elements, 122 restraints, 156 rigids, 6 displacements, no force block). Do not merge this PR or implement a writer under it before separate authorization and validation.
